note: The six logical pose IDs are fixed by scripts/pose_protocol.py (POSE_IDS). Do not add, rename, or drop one. Only speaking_direct may carry physical variants, and at most POSE_VARIANT_MAX_COUNT=4 of them.

delivery_contract.frame_count_note: LTX 2.3 latent video length must satisfy this; the ComfyUI graph computes it in node 5639. duration_seconds is always frame_count/fps, which is why every certified duration ends in .041667.

speaking_variant_policy.note: The chat model never sees variant IDs. It emits semantic delivery labels only; the router rotates variants on new assistant turns and reuses the same physical render when a turn_id is retried.

renders.why: The user called this motion essentially perfect; idle and listening intentionally share one physical file.
Calmer default speaking render: straight camera gaze with two slow sagittal micro-adjustments only.

Occasional faster natural accents on alternating turns without widening the movement envelope. Drop this render first when cutting cost; the manifest then carries speaking_direct with no variants array.
One compact 0.4 s yes gesture surrounded by stillness, not a slow multi-second bow.
Slow readable empathetic tilt; earlier faster versions were rejected as excessive.
Balanced between an imperceptible micro-smile and an overly broad smile.

full.note: Matches the live production bank. Use for language-agnostic characters and for the flagship character of each high-traffic language.

core.note: Drops only the V15 speaking variant. All six logical pose IDs still resolve. Recommended default for the 104-language bulk run.

minimal.note: Reaction poses alias the idle loop in the emitted manifest so the wire contract still exposes six IDs. Visibly degraded: nods, empathy, and smiles stop reading as distinct. Use only for a smoke test or a long-tail language, never for a launch language.
